description: Hi, I’m Boza, a Big Data Administrator based in Linz with a software engineering and computer science background. I work daily with data pipelines and streaming tools (Kafka, Flink, NiFi). I’m especially interested in AI, local LLMs and automation. On my team you’ll get someone who can handle the backend, data and deployment side reliably, so we can focus on building something real.
summary:
pace Mission Design Game is an open-source browser game where players take a space mission from concept to operations, alone or as a team of up to four sharing one screen. Each player has a role taken from a real NASA mission team: Launch, Spacecraft, Ground or Science. Missions include Wildfire Watch, a satellite in low Earth orbit that spots wildfires early, and Lunar Ice Hunter. The phases follow NASA JPL's mission development stages.

Players build a spacecraft from real parts, using data from NASA's Small Spacecraft Technology report and Launch Library 2. They then pick a rocket and an orbit. A live dashboard shows how each choice changes mass, power, budget, data, communications and schedule. The mission then launches in 3D and has to get through random events. A report at the end explains why it succeeded or failed. Players can change the design and fly the same mission again. An optional AI Mission Control shows two AI agents designing a mission and fixing a bad launch while it flies.

This matters because students rarely get to see a whole mission work as one system. The game turns abstract engineering trade-offs into hands-on experience they learn from by trying.
